Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

sensorstrings 2.0.0

Generated by Claude Opus 5.5

Breaking changes

Removed or renamed functions

  • ss_leaflet_station_map() is now ss_map_stations().
  • ss_coords_from_ddm_to_dd() is replaced by ss_convert_coords_from_ddm_to_dd(). The new function takes a data frame, not a vector. It converts every column ending in _n_ddm, _s_ddm, _e_ddm or _w_ddm, and takes the sign from the hemisphere letter.
  • filter_dat_to_plot() is now ss_filter_dat_to_plot().
  • ss_create_variable_labels() and ss_create_variable_labels_no_newline() are now internal.
  • ss_assemble_region_data() and ss_convert_old_log() have been removed.

Renamed and reordered arguments

  • ss_ggplot_variables(): color_palette is now colour_palette, color_col is now colour_col, and axis_label_newline is now yaxis_newline.
  • ss_plot_variables(): color_palette is now colour_palette. The title argument has been removed.
  • ss_import_data(): input_path is now path.
  • ss_create_log_from_metadata(): path_export is now output_path and path_metadata is now path. The new order is (output_path, station, deployment_date, path, ...).
  • ss_set_up_folders(): path is now path_output, and it comes after station and depl_date.
  • ss_create_template(): station and depl_date no longer have defaults.

Changed behaviour

  • ss_plot_variables() now returns a patchwork object instead of a ggarrange() figure. ggpubr is no longer a dependency.
  • ss_ggplot_variables() no longer calls ggplot2::theme_set(), so it leaves your global theme alone.
  • ss_set_up_folders() and ss_create_template() now need depl_date in "yyyy-mm-dd" format.
  • ss_read_log() stops with an error if the log is not a .csv, .xlsx or .xls file.
  • ss_create_log_from_metadata() stops with an error, instead of a warning, when no rows match the station and deployment date.
  • leaflet, mooring, plotly, sf and shiny are now in Suggests. Install them to use ss_map_stations(), ss_model_mooring(), ss_open_trimdates_app() and the ss_check_station_*() functions.
  • patchwork 1.3.2 or later is now required.

New features

  • ss_compile_vdat_data() compiles tilt (tilt_degree) as well as depth and temperature.
  • ss_export_path() and ss_import_path() take a path argument, so they can be used away from the CMAR R drive.
  • Side-effect functions such as ss_export_county_files() return the paths of the files they write, invisibly.
  • Variable names, labels and plot order come from one internal table (ss_vars), so all functions use the same names.
  • Every exported function has a runnable example.

Bug fixes

  • File names with more than one . are now read correctly.
  • ss_compile_vemco_data() works on VR2AR files without tilt.
  • Duplicate timestamps in vdat files are removed before pivoting, so they no longer create list-columns.
  • ss_parse_log() warns and keeps the first value when a log has more than one string configuration, instead of stopping with an error.
  • ss_set_up_folders() no longer treats a station as existing when its name only partly matches another station’s folder.
  • ss_import_data() only reads .rds files.
  • ss_plot_variables() applies the standard y-limits to dissolved_oxygen_uncorrected_mg_per_l.
  • ss_ggplot_variables() no longer errors on NA temperatures.
